findings.issue: `isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_submatrix_iff` has no call site, and its content is star-free: it is `IsFiniteType (A.submatrix e e) ↔ IsFiniteType A` for an `Equiv`, specialized to `A := starCartanMatrix m`. Together with `isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_comp` and `_comp_iff` that is the same general fact written three times at the star level.

summary: The main theorem still carries an avoidable `∀ i, ℓ i ≠ 0` hypothesis: the A-chain identification it needs is already proved privately in the same file, and `valid_A` needs nothing. Separately, the star-free fact "finite type is invariant under an equiv reindexing" is restated three times at the star level, one of them with no call site.
